concepts.gloss_en: The Light of the Face/Countenance — divine illumination, renewal of the mind/soul
The drawing-down/channeling of the Light of the Face — the act of eliciting the light, not the light itself

members.note: distinct construct head (המשכת = drawing-down); an action about אור הפנים, not the thing (Rule 4)

concepts.gloss_en: The shining/radiance of the Light of the Face — the event/manner of its shining forth, not the light itself

members.note: distinct construct head (זריחת = shining); state/action about אור הפנים, tied to 'וזרח' imagery (Rule 4)

notes: Token-overlap only. Base noun אור הפנים and the two construct phrases share the head but differ in the possessing/action head (המשכת = channeling, זריחת = shining), so per Rule 4 they are kept separate. No orthographic merges needed.
